response.sql:
WITH per_circuit AS (
  SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.date > '1978-03-04'
    AND r.date < '2003-03-09'
  GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
), ranked AS (
  SELECT circuitId, country, race_count,
         1.0 * race_count / AVG(race_count) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS ratio
  FROM per_circuit
)
SELECT circuitId, country, race_count, ratio
FROM ranked
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A circuit is included when it has at least one race within the date range; circuits with zero races are not part of the per-circuit averages or results.
